text:
raghav: Originating RC rc-20260115-lite at artifact sha:abcde12345. Small quantization profile change for dedicated pools. Quiet window 03:00-04:00 UTC. Need a quick sheriff + QA thumbs for canary-only rollout.

deploy-bot: [CI] rc-20260115-lite build OK. unit/integration/smoke all passed. Release notes: https://go.internal/release-notes/rc-20260115-lite

priya: Any DB changes or flag leaks to global?

raghav: No DB work. Flag scoped to tag `quant-lite` only. snippet: `model.quant.profile = { scope: \"quant-lite\" }`

qa: Ran staging smoke and a quick eval set. p50/p90 stable, small p99 noise but within baseline. QA +1 for canary.

sheriff: I'll cover the quiet window. I need commit sha, rollback artifact, and clear abort criteria before green light.

raghav: commit sha: abcde12345. rollback to sha:ff00ff00 (rc-stable). Abort if error rate >1% OR p99 latency increases by >50% sustained for 10m. Also abort if rerank_exact_match drops >0.5%. Runbook: /runbooks/rc-rollback.md

deploy-bot: Promotion example:
```
/deploy promote --env=prod --rc=rc-20260115-lite --artifact=sha:abcde12345 \
  --canary-stages=5,30,100 --quiet-window=03:00-04:00UTC --notify=@sheriff \
  --notes-url=https://go.internal/release-notes/rc-20260115-lite
```

priya: Requesting staging pattern: 5% for 12m, 30% for 20m, then 100%. Watch rerank and token-cost.

sheriff: Acknowledged. I'll watch dashboards and hold pager.

raghav: Kicking promotion now. @deploy-bot promote please.

deploy-bot: ACTION by raghav: scheduled promotion at 03:05 UTC. Stage 1: 5% canary deploy starting... done. Health: passing.

qa: Smoke against canary looks clean.

deploy-bot: Stage 2: moving to 30% traffic. Rolling update... routing updated. Health: passing. Telemetry shows a small p99 blip in one region (+22%) but below abort.

sheriff: Observing — blip noted, but within tolerated window. error rate 0.4%.

priya: If blip persists >10m, abort to be safe.

raghav: Agreed. We'll hold if it goes past 10m. So far looks transient.

deploy-bot: Stage 3: promoting to 100% traffic. Rolling update across zones; ETA ~6m.

deploy-bot: Promotion complete. All regions at rc-20260115-lite artifact sha:abcde12345. Post-deploy checks green.

qa: Starting 30m postdeploy evals. Initial metrics stable; token-cost down slightly as expected.

sheriff: Marking rollout stable. Closing quiet window early at 03:38 UTC.

raghav: Pinning artifact to rc/lite/20260115 and updating changelog. Thanks everyone.

deploy-bot: Reminder — rollback command if needed:
```
/deploy rollback --env=prod --to-artifact=sha:ff00ff00 --reason=\"regression EV-xxxx\"
```

priya: Noted, filing a small follow-up ticket EV-6001 for the transient p99 blip investigation. Not blocking.

raghav: We'll triage EV-6001 next sprint unless it regresses. Leaving thread open for 24h for visibility. :white_check_mark:
